WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT id, name, parent_id, icon, description, order_num, is_active, 0 AS depth, ARRAY[order_num] AS path, created_at, updated_at FROM study_categories WHERE parent_id IS NULL AND is_active = true
UNION ALL
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id, c.icon, c.description, c.order_num, c.is_active, ct.depth + 1, ct.path || c.order_num, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM study_categories c INNER JOIN category_tree ct ON c.parent_id = ct.id WHERE c.is_active = true ) SELECT * FROM category_tree ORDER BY path
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_categories (name, parent_id, icon, description, order_num) VALUES ( #{name}, #{parentId}, #{icon}, #{description}, COALESCE( #{orderNum}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(order_num), 0) + 1 FROM study_categories WHERE parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{parentId}) ) )
mapper.update: UPDATE study_categories SET name = #{name}, parent_id = #{parentId}, icon = #{icon}, description = #{description}, order_num = #{orderNum}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
